what.text: This page follows refugees from Burundi living in Rwanda, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 50746 Burundian refugees in Rwanda, 15.9% of all refugees from Burundi.
Tanzania hosts the most Burundian refugees, followed by Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in 1965 and in many years from 1991, at war level in some of them.
In its most recent periods the opponents it records include RED-TABARA and FPB from 2014 to 2015, and RED-TABARA and FNL-Ubugabo-Burihabwa from 2019 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1965 at 3000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 250000, at the end of 1993, the main year of displacement in the data, and was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Rwanda.
These are year-end totals for Rwanda only, reported to UNHCR.
